_comment: The frozen contract, as data. EXACTLY the shape GET /api/runs/latest/findings returns. Build the console against this file and you never need the backend running. Do not change field names -- the service is written against this same file. Every value below is MEASURED from data/sample (a real 2.89MB slice of the provided dataset): real vendor names, real offices, real business units, real OTA figures. Nothing here is invented.

findings.action: Check the delay-reason split in the breakdown before escalating: driver delay is a vendor conversation, employee delay is a comms one, traffic is a routing one.
findings.evidenceSql:
SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN actual_end_epoch <= planned_end_epoch + 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / nullif(count(*), 0)
FROM trips t
WHERE t.scheduled_at >= 1785024000000 AND t.scheduled_at < 1785542400000
  AND t.actual_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.trip_direction = 'LOGIN'

findings.action: Move volume off Vikram Mikhailov Travel to the top-quartile vendors at this site, and put it on the next vendor review.
findings.evidenceSql:
SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN actual_end_epoch <= planned_end_epoch + 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / nullif(count(*), 0)
FROM trips t
WHERE t.scheduled_at >= 1785024000000 AND t.scheduled_at < 1785542400000
  AND t.actual_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.vendor_id = 'Vikram Mikhailov Travel'

findings.action: Audit escort sign-ins at Clearwater Campus for the affected trips. A female employee cannot board before a marshal signs in, so this is a safety breach and not a metric miss.
findings.evidenceSql:
SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN t.actual_escort THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / nullif(count(*), 0)
FROM trips t
WHERE t.scheduled_at >= 1785024000000 AND t.scheduled_at < 1785542400000
  AND t.dark_hours AND t.carries_female_rider
  AND t.site_id = 'Clearwater Campus'

findings.action: Compare the affected shift's release time against cab arrival -- logout slippage is usually a dispatch-window problem, not a vendor one.
findings.evidenceSql:
SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN actual_end_epoch <= planned_end_epoch + 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / nullif(count(*), 0)
FROM trips t
WHERE t.scheduled_at >= 1785024000000 AND t.scheduled_at < 1785542400000
  AND t.actual_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.trip_direction = 'LOGOUT'
  AND t.site_id = 'Cedar Ridge Office'

findings.action: Look at what changed for vanta-Aus in the last week -- this is a move against its own history.
findings.evidenceSql:
SELECT 1000.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.severity = 'Sev-1') / nullif(count(DISTINCT t.trip_id), 0)
FROM trips t LEFT JOIN alerts a ON a.trip_id = t.trip_id
WHERE t.scheduled_at >= 1785024000000 AND t.scheduled_at < 1785542400000
  AND t.business_unit = 'vanta-Aus'

findings.action: Share the no-show list with the line managers for catalyst-Sac; confirmed no-shows are billable capacity nobody used.
findings.evidenceSql:
SELECT 100.0 * sum(noshow_cnt) / nullif(sum(plannedemployee_cnt), 0)
FROM trips t
WHERE t.scheduled_at >= 1785024000000 AND t.scheduled_at < 1785542400000
  AND t.business_unit = 'catalyst-Sac'

findings.action: Look at what changed for this population in the last week -- this is a move against its own history.
findings.evidenceSql:
SELECT avg((route_rating + driver_rating + cab_rating + safety_rating) / 4.0)
FROM feedback f JOIN trips t ON t.trip_id = f.trip_id
WHERE t.scheduled_at >= 1785024000000 AND t.scheduled_at < 1785542400000
  AND f.route_rating > 0

SELECT sum(b.trip_cost) / nullif(sum(b.total_trip_km), 0)
FROM bill b JOIN trips t ON t.trip_id = b.trip_id
WHERE t.scheduled_at >= 1785024000000 AND t.scheduled_at < 1785542400000
  AND t.mode = 'BUS'

findings.action: Share the late-pickup list for Pooja Mikhailov Travel with the vendor's dispatch lead -- pickup slippage is a routing or driver-reporting problem, not an employee one.
findings.evidenceSql:
SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN e.actual_pickup_at > e.planned_pickup_at + 300000
                        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / nullif(count(*), 0),
       count(*) AS n
FROM emp_legs e JOIN trips t ON t.trip_id = e.trip_id
WHERE t.scheduled_at >= 1784937600000 AND t.scheduled_at < 1785542400000
  AND e.planned_pickup_at IS NOT NULL AND e.actual_pickup_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.vendor_id = 'Pooja Mikhailov Travel'

findings.action: Look at what changed in cab occupancy for orbit-Slc over the last few weeks -- a rising cost per rider usually means falling seat utilisation, not falling volume.
findings.evidenceSql:
SELECT sum(bt.trip_cost) / nullif(sum(t.actualemployee_cnt), 0),
       count(*) AS n
FROM (SELECT trip_id, sum(trip_cost) AS trip_cost FROM bill GROUP BY trip_id) bt
JOIN trips t ON t.trip_id = bt.trip_id
WHERE t.scheduled_at >= 1784937600000 AND t.scheduled_at < 1785542400000
  AND t.actualemployee_cnt IS NOT NULL AND t.actualemployee_cnt > 0
  AND t.business_unit = 'orbit-Slc'

causeBreakdown._comment: GET /api/findings/{id}/causes for finding 563931f15cdd. delay_reason is a REAL COLUMN on the trip row -- values NODELAY, TRAFFIC, DRIVER, EMPLOYEE -- so this is a GROUP BY, not a derivation. Counts measured from data/sample.

brief.text:
For the Transport & Facilities Head:
Commute operations, 2026-07-25..2026-07-31

Four items need attention.

[BREACH] On-time arrival - overall
  59.10%, against an SLA target of 100.00% and a 4-week average of 61.40%.
  Traffic, employee and driver delays split the shortfall 40/34/26.

[BREACH] Vendor on-time share - vendor Vikram Mikhailov Travel
  32.31%, against a peer median of 59.10%.
  Cause: behind comparable peers.

[BREACH] Marshal compliance (dark hours) - site Clearwater Campus
  93.60%, against an SLA target of 100.00%.

[CONCERN] Sev-1 alerts per 1,000 trips - tenant vanta-Aus
  14.80, against a 4-week average of 9.60.
  Confidence in this figure is 88% - some alert rows carry an unreadable severity.

Move volume off Vikram Mikhailov Travel and audit Clearwater Campus escort sign-ins.
